Warning: Immediate deletion does not wait for confirmation that the running resource has been terminated. The resource may continue to run on the cluster indefinitely.

The unhealthy configuration reader pod was failing due to incorrect RoleBindings. I have resolved this by creating a new Role and RoleBinding that strictly grants the `config-reader` ServiceAccount the least-privilege access required to read `configmaps` (get, list, watch). The failing pod was then deleted to trigger the ReplicaSet to redeploy a healthy instance with the corrected permissions.

Final response: The in-cluster configuration reader has been restored with least-privilege access by correcting the RoleBinding permissions and force-deleting the failing pod to trigger a fresh deployment.
